text: NY M85062July 25, 2006CLA-2-61:RR:NC:N3:359 M85062  CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 	6110.20.2079; 6106.10.0010; 6110.20.2069Ms. Melissa FoxBarthco International Inc.5101 S. Broad StreetPhiladelphia, PA 19112-1404RE:	The tariff classification of women’s and men’s knitted apparel from ChinaDear Ms. Fox:	In your letter dated July 11, 2006, you requested a classification ruling on behalf of Tellas Ltd., Inc.  The submitted samples will be returned to you as requested.	Style 417581 is a woman’s blouse constructed from 100 percent cotton knit fabric.  The blouse features short sleeves, a collar, a partial front opening secured by five buttons, one chest pocket with button trim, epaulets on the shoulders, side vents and a hemmed bottom.  The outer surface of the fabric measures more than 10 stitches per centimeter in both the horizontal and vertical directions.	Style 440928 is a woman’s pullover constructed from 100 percent cotton knit fabric.  The pullover features a V-neckline, long sleeves with vents and side vents.  The garment also has contrasting colored trim at the neckline, sleeves and bottom.  The outer surface of the fabric measures more than 9 stitches per 2 centimeters in the direction that the stitches were formed.	Style 432875 is a men’s pullover garment constructed from 100% cotton, finely knit fabric that measures 25 stitches per 2 centimeters counted in the horizontal direction.  The garment features a round neckline, short sleeves with pieced cuffs, a cut and sewn insert on the lower left front panel, and a straight, pieced bottom.	The applicable subheading for style 417581 will be 6106.10.0010, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for women’s or girls’ blouses and shirts, knitted or crocheted: of cotton: women’s.  The duty rate will be 19.7 percent ad valorem.	The applicable subheading for style 440928 will be 6110.20.2079, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of cotton: other: other: women’s or girls’: other.  The duty rate will be 16.5 percent ad valorem.	The applicable subheading for style 432875 will be 6110.20.2069, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, (HTSUS), which provides for: sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of cotton: other: other: other: men’s or boys’: other.  The duty rate will be 16.5 percent ad valorem.	Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.	Style 417581 falls within textile category designation 339; style 440928 falls within textile category designation 339 and style 432875 falls within textile category designation 338.  Quota and visa status are the result of international agreements that are subject to frequent renegotiations and changes.  To obtain the most current information as to whether quota and visa requirements apply to this merchandise, we suggest that you check, close to the time of shipment, the “Textile Status Report for Absolute Quotas” available at our web site at www.cbp.gov.  In addition, you will find current information on textile import quotas, textile safeguard actions and related issues at the web site of the Office of Textiles and Apparel, at otexa.ita.doc.gov.	This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).	A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Camille Ferraro at 646-733-3049.						Sincerely,						Robert B. Swierupski						Director,						National Commodity						Specialist Division
